_comment_memory: Replay CHIA DEU theo lop: memory_per_class = 10.000 exemplar moi lop moi client (herding), giong HFIN exemplar.py:61 m = memory_size // total_classes. Lop Benign bi chan o 10.000; lop hiem co bao nhieu giu bay nhieu (double ~2.960 -> giu 100%). Khoa memory_ratio 0.01 con lai chi de tuong thich nguoc - utils/memory.py:36 uu tien memory_per_class nen memory_ratio KHONG con hieu luc. _comment_proto_agg: Per-class reliability-aware prototype aggregation: r_ic = bn*norm(log(1+n)) - bs*sigma + bq*q - bd*drift - bu*update_norm. So hang quy mo duoc CHUAN HOA min-max theo size_term_mode (giong Q_i). Ban cu cong thang log1p(n): log1p(29.000.000)=17,18 vs log1p(365)=5,90, tau=1 => ti so trong so 79.235:1, tuc bon so hang do tin cay con lai (deu trong [0,1]) nam duoi nguong nhieu va phep gop thuc chat chi la lay prototype cua client nhieu mau nhat.
